detail: Timestamp-quantization x power matrix needs browser flags x power states (AC vs battery, low_power_mode on/off) with a resolution floor per setting. Only one power state is available programmatically on this machine (AC/100%/lpm-off, thermal clean); the harness cannot switch AC<->battery without a human unplug, so the power axis has zero variance and the throttling half of the matrix is unmeasurable here. No synthetic throttling numbers written; no out/quant-throttle.json created.
